LanguageData.ARIO_EquipmentTrayHelp:
Equipment appearance
Change heraldry, cloth colors, gambeson patterns or tabard order. Plant carried banners. Only available equipment options are shown.
LanguageData.ARIO_EquipmentTrayDyeTip: Remove the tabard's applied dye and restore its regional or automatic House colors. Its chosen crest stays the same.
LanguageData.ARIO_TabardGorgetToggleTip: Show the tabard over or under a gorget. This changes appearance, not protection. Cloaks always cover it. Mixed selections switch to front first.
